state_features.suggestion_scope: Model selects a spatial seed. Independent bounded neighboring candidates may move different subsets of nodes; no logical layer is translated as a requirement.
state_features.layout_scope: Gate-level tiles and prior routes; low density does not certify a legal move.
state_features.route_path_encoding: Exact rectilinear polyline bend points, not a unit-step list.

rules.port_coordinate_scope: PI/PO node XY are fixed; this does not pin phases or detailed terminal orientation.
rules.objective: Reduce actual routed bounding area and exported QCA cells; both non-increasing, one strictly improved. Distinguish node-box proxy from actual routed area.
rules.routing_execution: The supplied complete routing_order is executed once by A*, with no order fallback. A failed candidate consumes the evaluation and returns diagnostics.
rules.search_contract: Select a seed whose internal region has room for local node relocation or detour removal. The selected exact seed is tried first, followed by up to batch_size-1 explicitly logged deterministic neighboring placements/orders. Each native call runs its exact order once. All original hard rules apply. A failed candidate is not an exhausted region. The best retained result never regresses. A separately recorded certified exploration state can temporarily increase area/cells by at most 10% relative to that best result.
